name: com.cidonix.unibridge
description: Local MCP tools that let AI coding agents inspect, edit, capture, and validate Unity Editor projects through a per-project bridge and relay.

_upm.changelog:
### Fixed

- Editor readiness and Play/Edit wait timeouts remain failures through checkpoints and reconnect recovery.
- ReloadCheckpoint retains applied refresh/reopen evidence with completed=false if waiting fails.
- Relay 1.1.0-build.21 requires affirmative readiness and target state, shares one recovery deadline, and only falls back on explicit unsupported Action.
- MCP isError reflects nested tool/wait failures; interrupted waits cannot claim completion.
- Legacy readiness aliases disclose instantaneous probes and fail when busy.

### Added

- Focused production-source EditorWaitRegression harness.
